export.title: Export
export.description: Export all your budget data (periods, categories, and transactions) as a CSV file. The file can be opened in Excel, Google Sheets, or any spreadsheet application.

backup.title: Backup
backup.description: Your finance data is stored in a single encrypted file. To back it up, simply copy that file to a safe location.
backup.step1: Close the app (or ensure no writes are in progress).
backup.step2: Navigate to the file location shown below.
backup.step3: Copy the .db file to your backup destination (USB drive, cloud folder, etc.).
backup.step4: To restore, simply open the backed-up file with this app.
backup.tip: The file is encrypted with your password. Anyone with the file still needs the password to open it.
backup.revealError: Could not open the file explorer. Please navigate to the file manually.
